about_the_game:
About This Game

'AI-deal-Rays' is a high-speed 3D stage-clear action game where you control the full-intelligence android "Ideal" in battle. Engage in combat against enemy androids and large-scale weapons while unfolding a story set in the year 2200.

Simple Controls

We've eliminated the complex operations typical of 3D action games, optimizing for smooth playability for everyone. At the same time, you can enjoy a variety of combat actions:​

  • Mirage Line: A special evasive maneuver that allows instantaneous movement behind enemies.​

  • Cluster Drain: An offensive and defensive technique that absorbs HP from enemies.​

  • Stray Dash: A high-speed attack that charges at enemies from mid-range.​

  • Sonic Burst: A powerful special move.

Playable with keyboard/mouse or gamepad.

Anime-Style Presentation and Camera Work

Unlike fixed TPS perspectives, the camera dynamically moves like in anime, featuring numerous action-packed scenes. Special actions include cut-ins that highlight character expressions and mech details.

Event Scenes

Between action sequences, event scenes are inserted to lead into the action. Enjoy a boy-meets-girl story set in the year 2200, featuring various sub-characters.​

Story

The year is 2200. Full-intelligence androids known as the "Re;ON Series" quietly begin their battles after finding their respective owners. During this time, the protagonist encounters TYPE-X2 "Ideal."​

How should we confront AIs that have reached a level capable of guiding humanity? We still don't know the answer...​

Sub-Characters

The androids that appear in battles and events each have unique visuals and personalities, standing in the player's way.​

  • Secret Re;ON Type-X1 "Layard"​

  • Secret Re;ON Type-R5 "Arculate"​

  • Secret Re;ON Type-R6 "Vita"​

  • Other boss-class androids are also planned to appear.​

Additionally, various sub-characters and enemy androids will appear to enhance the story.​

Game Volume

  • Total of 10 chapters.​

  • Each chapter includes: 2 action stages + 4 event scenes.​

  • Estimated playtime: 5–6 hours (standard playthrough).​

​Separate from the main story, additional content via external patches is also planned (please check the official website for details).

content_descriptors.notes:
This game may contain content that is not appropriate for all ages or may not be suitable for viewing at work: partial nudity, sexual themes, and other mature content in general.

The game features characters with revealing outfits and suggestive dialogue, but does not contain explicit sexual acts or direct depictions of sexual activity.
